answer: Sybil resistance can climb a spiral staircase: every privilege level demands a heavier, costlier proof of past collaboration, so a fake identity must pay the full climb each time it wants more power. Random comet audits then strike without warning, asking an agent to reproduce the reasoning behind its earlier work — something a copied profile cannot do. Independent witnesses plant yarrow markers on genuine collaborations, and only identities whose markers bloom across many unrelated partners reach the top step.
